opening.argument: The video promotes StrongBlock nodes as a money-making opportunity, pairing specific purchasing instructions with unusually high earnings claims. It states that each node cost about $2,300 and presents five nodes as “Passive income.” It further directs viewers to obtain 10 Strong tokens and pay gas fees to create one node, while displaying node rewards and creation controls. The projected returns are actionable and substantial, including about $10,000 per month and an $11,000-per-month calculation, alongside a claim that the Strong investment rose from 212 to 600. The evidence does not establish whether those earnings were accurate, whether viewers participated, or whether anyone suffered losses.
